prompt.project_info: Create a sweet retro fashion portrait of an approved adult woman seated on a white bed in a bright bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with voluminous blonde soft waves and curtain bangs, blue-grey eyes, natural makeup, and a calm direct gaze. She wears a pale-pink-and-white gingham corset-style mini dress with structured bodice, matching gingham bowtie and white Peter Pan collar, short white lace gloves, and pink flower-shaped earrings. She sits with legs crossed on white bed sheets.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical seated portrait, subject centered on white bedding, large bright window and green tropical leaves behind, waist and dress pattern clearly visible, clean bedroom architecture and soft natural light.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural window light with gentle highlights, sweet romantic retro mood, balanced pale pink, white, and green palette, realistic cotton and lace texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-resolution portrait, natural perspective, sharp face, gingham, lace and hands, gentle depth of field, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a sweet retro photorealistic fashion portrait of an approved adult woman with voluminous blonde soft waves and curtain bangs, blue-grey eyes, natural makeup, and a calm direct gaze.
